title: Step 5 - Coding Upper Confidence Bound: Optimizing Ad Selection in Python

cues.en: -: Okay, my friends, are you ready to now implement the step three of this upper confidence bound implementation?
cues.zh: 講師：朋友們，準備好實作信賴上界的第三步了嗎？

cues.en: We already implemented step two, and we even got these values for each of the ads, and now we need to use a trick to find the maximum of them.
cues.zh: 第二步已經完成，也取得各廣告的這些值，現在要用技巧找出最大值。

cues.en: All right, so in the last tutorial, we left things at this else, you know, else meaning if the numbers of selections of this ad number I we're dealing with right now
cues.zh: 上一堂停在 else；意思是目前第二個 for 迴圈處理的廣告 i，其選取次數

cues.en: in the second for loop is equal to zero, meaning if the ad was not selected yet.
cues.zh: 等於 0，也就是還沒被選過。

cues.en: Well, in that case, what we have to do is absolutely select it, right?
cues.zh: 這種情況下，必須選它，對吧？

cues.en: We must select it.
cues.zh: 一定要選它。

cues.en: If the ad has not been selected yet, we have to select it.
cues.zh: 如果還沒選過，就得選。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: That's because as we explained at the end of the previous tutorial, we need to make sure that the denominator NIN, which is the number of times that ad I was selected,
cues.zh: 正如上一堂結尾說明，必須確保分母 Nᵢ(n)，也就是廣告 i 被選的次數，

cues.en: is different than zero so that we can indeed compute the average reward and then the upper confidence bounds.
cues.zh: 不是 0，才能計算平均獎勵與信賴上界。

cues.en: So there is a priority now, you know, at the beginning, in the first round, to select all the ads.
cues.zh: 所以一開始的優先事項，是先選過所有廣告。

cues.en: And therefore, the trick that we have to use is to set the upper bound of this particular ad we're dealing with right now in the second for loop
cues.zh: 因此要用的技巧，是把第二個迴圈目前這個廣告的上界，

cues.en: to a super high value so that it will be indeed the maximum upper bound and therefore the one that will be selected, because at the end, we will, of course, select the ad with the highest upper confidence bound.
cues.zh: 設成超高的值，讓它成為最大上界而被選中，因為最後當然選信賴上界最高的廣告。

cues.en: So the trick right now is to take that variable again which so far, thanks to this if condition is equal to this value, but if we're not in this if condition
cues.zh: 現在再次取用這個變數；目前若符合 if，值就是這個，但若不符合 if，

cues.en: and if we are in this else, well, we would like that same variable to be equal to a super high value like infinity.
cues.zh: 進入 else，就希望同一個變數等於超高的值，例如無窮大。

cues.en: But we can't set it equal to infinity.
cues.zh: 但不能直接設成無窮大。

cues.en: However, we can set it equal to a super high value, like 1 times 10 at the power of 400.
cues.zh: 不過可以設超高值，例如 1 乘以 10 的 400 次方。

cues.en: That's a classic trick in Python to use the infinity.
cues.zh: 這是 Python 中使用無窮大的常見技巧。

cues.en: This is a super high value, which will definitely be the maximum of the upper bound, so that if that ad was not selected yet, well, we will select it because indeed it will have the maximum
cues.zh: 這個超高值肯定會是最大上界，所以如果廣告尚未被選，就會選它，因為它的

cues.en: of the upper confidence bound.
cues.zh: 信賴上界最大。

cues.en: And now we need to finish with a final if condition to make sure that indeed we select the ad with the highest upper confidence bound.
cues.zh: 現在最後加上 if，確保確實選信賴上界最高的廣告。

cues.en: And the trick to do that is to play with max upper bound here, which so far is initialized to zero, you know, before we start this second for loop, and that upper bound.
cues.zh: 技巧是搭配這裡的 max_upper_bound，第二個迴圈開始前初始化為 0，與 upper_bound。

cues.en: And the if condition that we have to add here is to check if, well, the upper bound of the ad we're dealing with right now
cues.zh: 要加的 if，就是檢查目前第二個迴圈處理的廣告，

cues.en: in the second for loop in which we've just computed either through this first if condition or in this else, we have to check if that upper bound is larger
cues.zh: 其上界剛才透過第一個 if 或 else 計算出來後，是否大於

cues.en: than the maximum upper bound, right?
cues.zh: 目前最大上界，對吧？

cues.en: Because, okay, at the beginning, before we started this for loop, max upper bound is equal to zero, then we will compute this for the first ad.
cues.zh: 因為迴圈開始前 max_upper_bound 是 0，再計算第一個廣告，

cues.en: We will get either value if this ad had already been selected or we'll get this value.
cues.zh: 若它已被選過，得到這個值，否則這個值。

cues.en: And, of course, since this or this will be larger than zero, then this max upper bound will be updated, right?
cues.zh: 當然兩者都大於 0，所以 max_upper_bound 就會更新。

cues.en: And this is exactly our next step here.
cues.zh: 這正是下一步。

cues.en: If indeed upper bound is larger than this maximum upper bound, well, we need to update that max upper bound value,
cues.zh: 如果 upper_bound 確實大於 max_upper_bound，就要更新最大值，

cues.en: there we go, to be equal to that new upper bound just computed either through this if condition or this else.
cues.zh: 讓它等於剛透過 if 或 else 算出的新上界。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So upper bound, okay?
cues.zh: 所以是 upper_bound，好嗎？

cues.en: And then in the next step of this second for loop, well, we will compute a new value of the upper bound here if you know the ad was already selected.
cues.zh: 接著第二個迴圈的下一次迭代，若廣告已選過，會計算新的上界。

cues.en: And if this new value of the upper bound is larger than this new max upper bound which was just updated to the previous upper bound of the previous ad,
cues.zh: 如果新上界大於剛更新成上一個廣告上界的 max_upper_bound，

cues.en: well, we will update it again.
cues.zh: 就再更新。

cues.en: You see, the trick each time, at each iteration of the second for loop, we compute a new upper bound.
cues.zh: 所以技巧是，每次第二個迴圈迭代，都計算新上界。

cues.en: We compare that upper bound with the largest upper bound collected so far, you know, with the previous ads.
cues.zh: 拿它與先前廣告累積至今的最大上界比較。

cues.en: And if that new upper bound is larger than this maximum upper bound, well, we update the new maximum upper bound.
cues.zh: 若新上界更大，就更新最大上界。

cues.en: And, of course, for the ads that have not been selected yet, this upper bound will always be larger than the max upper bound and therefore this ad will be selected.
cues.zh: 當然，未選過的廣告，上界會大於目前最大值，所以會被選中。

cues.en: And speaking of this ad will be selected, well, that's exactly the final step we have to do here.
cues.zh: 說到選中廣告，這正是這裡最後要做的事。

cues.en: We have to select the ad and in order to select it, well, we need to update that variable here, ad equals zero to, of course, I,
cues.zh: 要選廣告，就要把這裡初始化為 0 的 ad，更新為 i，

cues.en: you know, the index I of that ad we're dealing with right now in the second for loop.
cues.zh: 也就是目前第二個迴圈處理廣告的索引。

cues.en: And that, my friend, that's how you implement step three, by making sure at the same time that you select the ad that was not selected yet.
cues.zh: 朋友，這就是第三步的實作，同時確保選中還沒選過的廣告。

cues.en: And at some point, after a couple of rounds, well, all the ads will be selected, well, you know, actually, after the ten first rounds, all the ads will automatically be selected and then we will only be in this condition,
cues.zh: 幾回合後，所有廣告都會選過；具體來說，前十回合後會自動全部選過，之後只會符合這個 if，

cues.en: this else condition will never happen after the ten first rounds, okay?
cues.zh: 前十回合之後就不再進入 else，好嗎？

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Now, congratulations.
cues.zh: 現在恭喜。

cues.en: This step three is implemented.
cues.zh: 第三步實作完成。

cues.en: We selected the I that has a maximum upper confidence bound.
cues.zh: 選出了信賴上界最大的 i。

cues.en: And now what we simply need to do is just finish this main code here, this cell, by going back to this first for loop,
cues.zh: 接著只要回到第一個 for 迴圈，完成這個儲存格的主要程式碼，

cues.en: iterating through the round, through the users who connect to the website.
cues.zh: 它走遍各個回合，也就是連上網站的使用者。

cues.en: And well, the way to do this is just to update each of these variables, which we created at the beginning before starting the for loop to indeed get that full list of all the ads selected
cues.zh: 做法是更新最初建立的各個變數，取得跨所有回合選中廣告的完整串列，

cues.en: over the round.
cues.zh: 記錄各回合的選擇。

cues.en: Then, of course, update this variable to update the numbers of selections for each of the ad.
cues.zh: 再更新這個變數，記錄每個廣告選取次數。

cues.en: Then, of course, update this one, which gives the accumulated rewards for each of the ads.
cues.zh: 再更新這個，記錄每個廣告的累積獎勵。

cues.en: And finally, update the total accumulated reward over the rounds, all right?
cues.zh: 最後更新各回合的總累積獎勵，好嗎？

cues.en: So, I will let you do this.
cues.zh: 留給你做。

cues.en: Please try to do it yourself before the next tutorial, and we will implement the solution together in the next tutorial, which will, at the same time, finish and complete that cell,
cues.zh: 下一堂之前請自己試，下一堂一起實作解法，同時完成這個儲存格，

cues.en: implementing the upper confidence bound algorithm.
cues.zh: 實作完整信賴上界演算法。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So good luck again and I'll see you in the next tutorial for the solution.
cues.zh: 再次祝好運，下一堂見，會看解答。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
